request.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. One real photograph for a Spanish-speaking adult beginner learning English. Natural everyday photographic detail, real material, skin and fabric texture, soft natural daylight and correct perspective; NOT an illustration, 3D render, cartoon, collage, cutout or app UI. Full-bleed 3:2 landscape; no frames, padding, blur bands, vignette, watermark or captions. A first-time learner must understand the picture instantly on a small phone screen. Nobody looks at the camera. Do not imitate earlier course photos.

A close photograph of the rustic wooden counter of a covered market stall, softly blurred market behind. In the middle of the counter stands one plain blue cloth tote bag standing upright, whole and sharp, and right beside it a small white price card standing on the counter, hand-written in black marker with a dollar sign and a numeral, large and sharp enough to read at a glance: it reads exactly $2. The card is clearly the price of this one thing. No people, no hands and nothing else on the counter. The only writing in the photo is the price card; no other letters, words, numbers or signs are readable anywhere.

cost.basis: Reported usage at list prices checked 2026-09-24; before tax, not an invoice.
